system.description:
Bard’s are heralds of the awe-inspiring beauty of creation. While the painter and sculptor decorate space, a Bard decorates time.


Iconic Bards

• Edward Chris von Muir, Final Fantasy IV

• Jaskier, The Witcher

• Kvothe, The Kingkiller Chronicle

• Sylvando, Dragon Quest XI


Playing Bards

The bard is a mid-defense, high-support class with a focus on optimizing your Group’s d20 rolls. It’s recommended that you avoid melee on most Bard builds.


Action: Virtuoso

Move: Midline/Backline

Starting Pack: Musician


Training: Finesse, Influence, Performance

features.name: VIrtuoso
features.description:
You can use your Action or skip your Move to choose one of the following benefits and make a Performance Check. If you pass, your

Group gains the benefit for that Round:


Inspiration: d6 bonus to Healing rolls

Resolve: Favor on Saves

Valor: Favor on Attack and Cast Checks

features.name: Well-Versed
features.description: You ignore Stat minimum Prerequisites for Perks, and gain a Perk of your choice.

features.name: Overtuned
features.description: If a d6 bonus you grant causes a d20 result to be 21 or higher, you gain 1 Luck. The result needed is reduced by 1 every 6 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Enjoy the Silence
features.description: You ignore effects that rely on you hearing them to be affected (such as a banshee’s scream), and you have Favor on Saves against being Berserk, Charmed, Confused, or Frightened.

features.name: Audacity
features.description: When you pass a Performance Check or Crit on any Save, you can cause a Being that can hear you to become Berserk, Charmed, Confused, or Frightened for Cd4 Rounds. Once this ends, they are immune to this Ability for the Shift.

features.name: Climax
features.description: Your bonus dice rolls and bonus dice rolls you grant can Explode.
